name: Hoco DAR43 Electric Hair Clipper
description:
Model: HOCO DAR43
Power Source: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery
Battery Life: Up to 180 minutes (3 hours)
Charging Time: 2-3 hours
Blade Material: Stainless steel (self-sharpening)
Cutting Length Range: 0.5mm – 25mm (adjustable with comb attachments)
Motor Type: High-performance, low-noise motor
Display: LED battery and length indicator
Weight: Lightweight and ergonomic (exact weight not specified)
Included Accessories:
Multiple comb attachments (guides)
Charging cable
Cleaning brush
Storage pouch
User manual
Durable Build – Made of ABS plastic and aluminum alloy for a sturdy and comfortable grip.
Sharp Blade – Powder metallurgy blade ensures precise and smooth cuts.
Compact & Lightweight – Measures 153mm x 35mm and weighs only 165g for easy handling.
Long Battery Life – 1600mAh battery provides up to 4.5 hours of use on a full charge.
Fast Charging – Fully charges in about 3 hours via USB.
Powerful Motor – 7000 RPM speed for efficient cutting performance.
5W Power Output – Optimized for smooth operation and consistent results.
Warranty: 3 Months
